invariance.name: Invariance
invariance.gist: What you may vary without moving the answer. Most laws are this one.

round-trip.name: Round trip
round-trip.template: There and back gives what you started with.
round-trip.gist: Render then parse, parse then print: nothing is lost on the way.

refinement.name: Refinement
refinement.template: With less in, an answer stays or becomes unknown. It never turns wrong.
refinement.gist: What a reader missing payloads is promised, and how it is told.

order.name: Order
order.template: Any two compare one way, and exactly one holds.
order.gist: Strict total orders and complements: no ties, no gaps.

exactness.name: Exactness
exactness.template: Accepted exactly when it fits; anything else is refused with a reason.
exactness.gist: Where the line is, stated as an if and only if, or a refusal that names itself.

limit.name: Limit
limit.template: This one moves, and here is who accounts for it.
limit.gist: What doesn't hold, said as plainly as what does.

incremental = batch.change: folding in parts or all at once

count.repeats.says: Deliver a record twice and the count moves: it is counted again. So the store must hand each id over once.

latest-by.set.change: how the records arrive, the set kept

latest-by.order.says: The winner is a head, newer than every other head: prev first, then the span, emitted, id.

content order.says: Any two records order one way: by span, then emitted, then id. Never by how a time is spelled.

sum.repeats.says: Deliver a record twice and the sum moves: it is added again. So the store must hand each id over once.

input.distinct.says: A fold is handed each id exactly once: the realm's union removes repeats.

acc.set.change: the order, for any step that commutes

acc.late.change: folding a late record onto the cached state

heads.set.change: how the records arrive, the set kept
heads.set.stays: any answer worked out from the heads

heads.late.change: folding a late record onto the cached heads

heads.why.says: Max can't follow prev: no step from its state and the next record keeps the current maximum. So folds over heads keep LatestBy's state instead.

view.no-resurrection.stays: the heads: a superseded record is never current

view.refines.says: Hide payloads and a where answer stays, or becomes unknown.

result.unread.says: A result counts the covered records it couldn't read, instead of guessing at them.

result.full.says: With every payload here, nothing is unread and the result is the plain fold.

select.set.change: how the records arrive, the set kept
select.set.stays: what is read and what is unread

settle.set.stays: what the reader keeps, one record per id

settle.keeps.says: A payload any place holds is kept, unless it is erased.

settle.erased.says: Once a record naming it in erases is held, every form of its target is erased.

admit.set.says: A record is refused exactly when it isn't entitled to its prev, and that depends only on the set.

admit.no-cross.says: An admitted record's prev names only held records it shares a thing with.

view.no-resurrection (things).stays: what is admitted, and each thing's state

where.complements.says: On any record exactly one of is and not holds, of present and absent, and on a number or a time, of at-least and below.

where.typed.says: A test is accepted exactly when its argument fits its field, and renders back as it was written.

where.fields.says: Each envelope field reads as exactly what it holds: a text as its text, a set as its members, emitted as its instant.

where.time.change: how a time is spelled, the record's or the test's

where.total.says: A test answers for every record whose payload is here, and an envelope test for every record at all.

where.set.change: the order of a where map's tests

view.refines (where).says: Under a view, a test and a where map keep their answer, or it becomes unknown.

spec.from-thing.says: from's about takes exactly the records about the thing; a record about nothing is about its own id.

spec.set.change: how the records arrive, the set kept

spec.after-supersession.says: A slot over heads returns only heads that from takes and every test holds for: selection never brings back what was superseded.

spec.parse.says: An accepted spec's parsed form parses back to itself, and the parser gives exactly the specs that fit.

batch.meaning.change: the order of a batch's drafts

batch.refuse.says: A label given twice, used but not given, or in a cycle is refused; so is a draft write refuses, and a prev not held or about other things.

batch.refuse-order.change: where in the batch the refusals are

lens.escaping.says: Any body survives rendering and parsing, backslashes and all.

lens.round-trip.says: Render, then parse, and you get back what you rendered.

lens.no-op.says: Parse an unedited render and there is nothing to apply.

lens.put-get.says: An edit that keeps the sections in order applies exactly, up to normal form.

lens.nothing-dropped.says: Every section is unchanged, accepted or reported; every dropped one is reported.

lens.absence-not-edit.change: dropping a section from the text
lens.absence-not-edit.stays: the state: absence is never an edit

lens.refuse.says: Malformed text is refused, not guessed at.

record.commit.says: A record's own salt and payload open its commitment.

record.sets.change: the order of about, prev or erases, and repeats in them

record.member-order.change: the order of an object's members

UTF-16 order.says: Any two distinct strings order one way, by UTF-16 code units.

record.refuse.says: A bad envelope, a salt that isn't 16 bytes, a repeated member name or a number past ±(2<sup>53</sup> − 1) is refused with a stated reason.

write.checked.says: write succeeds exactly when every check passes, and what it returns carries the proof.

write.member-order.change: the order of a written payload's members

occurred.span.says: Every text the reader accepts becomes the span the grammar gives it, and no span ends before it starts.

occurred.moment.change: trailing zeros in a fraction of a second

occurred.order.says: Spans order by start, then end, an open end last: every store orders them the same.

occurred.refuse.says: A text the reader doesn't accept is refused with occurred-not-span, never guessed at.

notTheorems.Written: a structure, not a theorem: what write returns, carrying the proof that every check passed

vectorTags.record.id: the id's definition, pinned byte for byte by the vectors; nothing to prove beyond computing it
vectorTags.record.sign: the signature's definition, checked against RFC 8032 values before any vector is written
vectorTags.record.canonical: the canonical bytes, RFC 8785, pinned by the vectors and the standard's own test data
vectorTags.record.emitted: emitted's grammar, which is its definition (instant?), pinned by the vectors

implementations.name: the model
implementations.what: lake exe gen writes every vector and checks each against its laws

demos.change: Deliver them in another order, the head's payload withheld
Render it, then parse the text
Drop a section from the text
